text: Note: The specialty is conducted in English with a prerequisite of a minimum number of 15 students for Bachelor’s degree. Before applying, pls contact SICAS for the latest information. Teaching Objectives After the course you will be equipped the knowledge of Civil engineering discipline and professional training experience for engineers; Qualified ability for the work of planning, design, construction, management and research in civil engineering projects. Graduates will be able to find great jobs in the field of housing construction, tunnel and underground construction, bridge construction and mine companies. Main Courses Advanced Math, Physics, Theoretical Mechanics, Building materials, Material Mechanics, Structural Mechanics, Soil Mechanics & Foundation Engineering, Concrete Structure, Steel Structure, and Architecture Construction,Elementary Chinese, Survey of China, Intermediate Chinese, Internship Practice, course design, surveying and mapping practice, graduation practice, graduation design. Degree Awarded Bachelor Degree of Engineering. Career You will be able to find great jobs in the field of housing construction, tunnel and underground construction, bridge construction and mine companies.
